newsitem.title: USA: Sony TV unit, Procter in deal.
newsitem.headline: Sony TV unit, Procter in deal.

text.p: Sony Corp's television production wing, Columbia TriStar Television Group, and Procter & Gamble Co's Procter & Gamble Productions on Monday unveiled a three-year agreement to develop television shows, including soap operas.

The companies will concentrate on primetime network and first run syndication programming, as well as daytime dramas. Each company will hold an equity stake in the programming effort, and they will share costs of development.
Columbia TriStar currently produces primetime network shows like "Mad About You," "The Nanny" and "Party of Five." Syndicated shows include "Wheel of Fortune" and "Jeopardy!"
Its soap opera interests include "The Young and The Restless" and "Days of Our Lives." Procter & Gamble produces "Guiding Light," "As The World Turns," and "Another World."
